name: auth-failure
description: A rejected login. The 401 must end the run with a clean message naming the credentials -- the old code decoded the login body and called .keys() on it BEFORE checking the status, so any non-JSON error body aborted the task with a decode error instead. 401 is not a retryable status, so exactly one login request may be made and no /devices request may follow.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.

log_contains: extreme-cloud-iq: check the username and password
